findings.candidate_quote: The study found no serious adverse events or cases of myocarditis/pericarditis.
findings.reference_quote: SAEs were reported by 0.0% (0/84) of the participants in the CV0701-Med group to 3.6% (3/84) in the CV0701-High group and by 3.5% (3/85) in the comparator group (Table 2).
findings.explanation: Serious adverse events occurred, although none were considered vaccine-related. The summary incorrectly converts absence of vaccine-related serious adverse events into absence of any serious adverse events.
